findings.caveat: House and Senate bill shares use enacted bills from each originating chamber divided by that chamber's introduced bills. Joint resolutions are excluded from those shares. The 274 laws include five House joint resolutions; dividing 274 by only House bills would mix origins and measure types. Vetoed measures include joint resolutions.

The one line-item veto is separately identified and must not be added to the 14 whole-bill vetoes.

gaps.scope: roll calls, committee outcomes and law subjects
gaps.finding: Introductions/enactments do not distinguish committee rejection from inaction or later floor failure. No commercially cleared direct study supports numerical district/party/conviction/lobbying choice weights. No individual vote chosen by passage percentage.

Bounded four-session/table sources cannot fulfill nationwide volume or typical council-size/type distributions. Kansas/Kentucky/Minneapolis source requests returned403 today; retained existing dated observations with access failure, not claimed newly revalidated.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
